name: Arisawa Kozue
source:
The manager at different branch of Fill Flower. She worked at around the same time as Hokuto. 
Despite her tall, mature, and cool appearance, she likes small and cute things. She often teases Chikashi, the part-time worker at the shop. She is caring and is a good advice giver for the protagonists.
